modules.name: Complaint Management
modules.description: Lets residents raise complaints with photos and tracks them through genuineness check, assignment and closure.

modules.name: Reports Dashboard
modules.description: Shows complaints of all projects in one dashboard.

modules.name: Resident Registration
modules.description: Handles resident self-registration, Society Manager approval and owner changes.

modules.name: Notice Board
modules.description: Project notice board where Raghuvir posts announcements to all or selected projects.

modules.name: Visitor Management
modules.description: Shows today's visitor list and records walk-in entries with entry and exit time.

modules.name: Hall Booking
modules.description: Allows in-app booking of the hall with a clash check.

modules.name: Event Invites
modules.description: Sends event invites and collects reply counts.

requirements.title: Resident raises complaint in app with photos
requirements.description: Residents raise complaints in the app with photos instead of calling or sending WhatsApp to the office.

requirements.title: Automatic complaint number
requirements.description: A complaint number is created automatically when a complaint is recorded.

requirements.title: Assign complaints by category and responsibility
requirements.description: Complaints are assigned by category and responsibility rather than staff calling vendors manually.

requirements.title: Single dashboard for all projects' complaints
requirements.description: All projects' complaints are visible in one dashboard.

requirements.title: Resident self-registration
requirements.description: Residents register themselves in the system, replacing the Excel kept by builder staff.

requirements.title: Handle owner change
requirements.description: On an owner change, the old user is deactivated and the new one is approved.

requirements.title: Project notice board announcements
requirements.description: Each project has a notice board, and Raghuvir can post announcements to all or selected projects.

requirements.title: Today's visitor list and walk-in entry
requirements.description: The system shows today's visitor list and records walk-in entries with entry and exit time.

requirements.title: In-app hall booking with clash check
requirements.description: Hall bookings are made in the app and the system checks for clashes.

requirements.title: Family and member counts by age group
requirements.description: The system records family and member counts by age group (Kids, Adults, Seniors) for every project.

requirements.title: Event invites with reply counts
requirements.description: Event invites are sent and reply counts are tracked instead of guessing attendance.

rules.title: Society Manager checks complaint genuineness first
rules.description: The Society Manager checks each complaint for genuineness before it proceeds.

rules.title: Closure only on resident approval
rules.description: A complaint is closed only when the resident approves, not when staff say it is done.

rules.title: Society Manager approves resident registration
rules.description: Self-registered residents need Society Manager approval.
